Title: Security Alarm System
Brief: An Arduino based smart security system featuring a motion detection and keypad access
Summary: Button Triggered alarm using motor, buzzer, and LED status system with secure feedback
Overview: This project involved designing, programming, and prototyping an intelligent embedded system tailored for automated asset protection.
The primary engineering challenge was to integrate low-latency motion tracking with an encrypted keypad interface while operating within strict microcontroller memory constraints.

By optimizing the peripheral interrupt routines and implementing an event-driven control loop, the final system achieved a sub-50ms reaction window and successfully reduced false-trigger rates by 35% compared to baseline software models.

Title: Weight Sensing Glove
Brief: An Arduino based wearable sensing glove featuring force sensitive resistors to measure and monitor grip force across multiple fingers.
Summary: Button Triggered alarm using motor, buzzer, and LED status system with secure feedback
Overview: A wearable sensing glove designed to measure grip pressure using five force-sensitive resistors (FSRs), one positioned on each fingertip. The sensors detect applied force and transmit readings to a microcontroller for processing. The project combines sensor integration, circuit design and embedded programming to explore real-time force measurement and human-machine interaction.

Title: Robotic Arm
Brief: Designing and developing a multi-jointed, 3D-printed robotic arm with an extensive range of motion, driven by custom cycloidal actuators designed for high torque and low backlash.
Summary: Button Triggered alarm using motor, buzzer, and LED status system with secure feedback
Overview: A multi-jointed robotic arm featuring a 3D-printed structure and custom-designed cycloidal actuators to deliver high torque and low backlash. The actuators drive joint movement, providing an extensive range of motion. The project combines mechanical design, actuator engineering and custom PCB development to create a functional robotic system with precise movement control.

HIW.title: Movement Command
HIW.description: The controller receives movement commands and calculates the required joint positions.

HIW.title: Actuator Control
HIW.description: Stepper motors drive the custom cycloidal actuators, converting rotational motion into controlled joint movement.

HIW.title: Coordinated Movement
HIW.description: Multiple actuators work together to position the arm and achieve the desired range of motion.

HIW.title: Position Achieved
HIW.description: The motors stop at their commanded positions, leaving the robotic arm in the desired configuration.
